blurb: Guests cruise St. Andrews Bay on a 120-passenger double-decker boat with air-conditioned cabin, restrooms, and a full bar. Offerings include a 3.5-hour Shell Island & Dolphin Watch Cruise with narrated sightseeing and about one hour to explore Shell Island, and a 1.5-hour Sunset Cruise & Dolphin Watch. Private charters and group bookings are available.
